## Faction Benefits

| Faction | Perks | Requirements |
|------|-------|---------------|
| Order | Temple services, gear discount | Donate 10%, defend faith |
| Shadow | Intelligence, quests | Complete tasks, secret |
| Guild | Trade discounts, connections | Membership fee, trade |
| Druids | Nature magic, safe travel | Respect nature |
| Thieves | Stealth, escape | Share loot, skill |

## Joining Requirements

| Faction | Alignment | Skill | Fee | Test |
|------|-----------|---------|------|----|----|
| Order | LG | Religion | 50 gp | Combat |
| Shadow | Any evil | Stealth | None | Theft |
| Guild | N | Persuasion | 100 gp | Trade |
| Druids | NG, N | Nature | 25 gp | Nature test |
| Thieves | CN, CE | Stealth | None | Stealth |

## Faction Quests

### Order
- Clear undead crypt
- Rescue captive priest
- Hunt demon cult
- Protect village

### Shadow
- Steal artifact
- Infiltrate guild
- Gather intelligence
- Eliminate target

### Guild
- Secure trade route
- Transport valuable cargo
- Negotiate deal
- Investigate competitor

### Druids
- Protect sacred grove
- Hunt poachers
- Heal wounded beast
- Stop corruption

### Thieves
- Steal from rich
- Rescue captured member
- Escape prison
- Plot heist
